description: §5.2 rule 1 (S464): a QUOTED event-handler attribute with no `${…}` (`onclick="go(1)"`, any case, top level and `<each>` row) is a compile error; the same text inside a `<pre>` raw-content body (§4.17) is display text and is not refused.
rationale: §5.2 rule 1 (S464): "A quoted event-handler attribute whose value holds no `${…}` SHALL be a compile error (E-ATTR-QUOTED-HANDLER)". Before the fix `onclick="go(1)"` was written into the page as an HTML attribute the browser ran as raw JavaScript, unchecked by scrml.
